Subject: RE: Private offer process (AWS/GCP) and channel margin — initial info request

Hi all — looping in GCP rep Marco so we have both marketplace lanes visible.

Quick notes on AWS private offers:

- AWS typically expects a marketplace listing or private offer via their PRV flow; seller needs to provide list price and the private offer discount.
- Channel margin: we usually see partners set a 15–20% margin; anything above ~20% will require additional approvals from the Partner team.
- Invoicing: if Acme wants marketplace-specific invoices, we'll need the billing entity data and the marketplace account IDs.
- Timeline: once we have the pricing sheet and PO language, PRV setup takes ~5–7 business days (assuming no special approvals).

I attached the standard AWS marketplace terms and the PRV checklist. If Redwood is offering a channel margin to a reseller, please indicate whether Redwood or the reseller will be the listing owner in AWS.

Regards,

Janelle Park
Partner Programs | AWS Marketplace
janelle.park@aws-partner.com

Attachments: AWS-marketplace-terms.pdf, AWS-PRV-Checklist.docx

Date: Sat, 14 Feb 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Private offer process (AWS/GCP) and channel margin — proposed pricing table

Thanks Priya and Janelle — based on your inputs we put together two pricing options and the channel margin treatment. Summary below; spreadsheet attached.

Option A — 12 month term (recommended for faster approval)
- List price (on-marketplace): $0.20 /k token usage equivalent
- Private offer discount to Acme: 30% off list -> effective price $0.14 /k token
- Channel margin to reseller: 18% of list ($0.036 /k token)
- Redwood net after margin & discounts: $0.104 /k token

Option B — 24 month term (committed)
- List price: $0.20 /k token
- Private offer discount: 40% off list -> effective price $0.12 /k token
- Channel margin to reseller: 15% of list ($0.03 /k token)
- Redwood net after margin & discounts: $0.09 /k token

Notes:
- We assumed reseller margin is calculated off list price per marketplace guidance; if Acme requires margin off discounted price we can adjust.
- Attached: Redwood-private-offer-template.xlsx (SKU mapping, term language, sample PO wording).

Next steps: Marissa — can you confirm which option Acme prefers and whether they want Redwood to be the listing owner in AWS/GCP or if they will route through a reseller? Once confirmed we'll produce the private offers for each marketplace and start PRV on the AWS side and the equivalent GCP workflow.

Best,

Rishi Malhotra
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com
